Rich text and in-place text editing

Drafted the next 3, all in discussing for your review:
- S-6 Canvas selection and direct manipulation (new Editor section, SEC-4): select any layer on the canvas (click, double-click to go deeper, cmd+click for deepest, shift and marquee for several), move, reorder flex children by drag, resize, nudge, delete, duplicate, copy and paste. Each gesture is one undo step.
- S-7 Styles panel editing (Editor): the right panel becomes an editor grouped like Paper (layout, size with Fixed/Hug/Fill, position, fill, border, shadow, text), plus a raw CSS view, multi-select with Mixed values, and inline notes for styles the engine drops.
- S-8 Rich text and in-place text editing (Document engine): text layers hold styled spans, so write_html and set_text_content stop flattening formatting, plus double-click to edit text on the canvas with cmd+B/I/U.
Why these three: they turn OpenDraw from something agents draw in into something you can edit by hand, and S-8 closes the main gap left in the MCP write tools. Pages, files and tokens come after.
Order I recommend: S-6, then S-7, then S-8. No open questions: where Paper and open-pencil differ I followed Paper.

Reqs 1-9 done. All 6 S-10 checks pass; full suite 65/65.

- The selection frame now follows each layer's rotation and carries its handles (src/canvas/handles.tsx). Handle sets per type: frames resize, rotate, radius (+ padding and gap when flex); images and SVGs resize, rotate, radius; text resize, rotate; artboards resize, radius (+ padding and gap when flex). Non-resize handles hide under 24 screen px.
- Rotate: drag just outside a corner; stored as rotate: Ndeg; shift snaps to 15; live angle label. Resizing a rotated layer works along its own axes and keeps the opposite edge fixed on screen.
- Corner radius dots: drag inward for border-radius on all corners (capped at half the shorter side); alt sets one corner (writes the four corner longhands).
- Padding handles (alt: opposite sides, shift: all four) and gap handles between children, with striped shading on hover and while dragging.
- Styles panel: Rotation field under Position (plain numbers are degrees). Agents: rotate accepted by update_styles/write_html, reported by get_computed_styles and get_jsx.
- Every handle drag is one undo step (src/canvas/Canvas.tsx).

Limits: outlines use the layer's own rotation only (a child inside a rotated parent gets an axis-aligned outline); value labels show while dragging, and hover shows the value as a tooltip.

The layers panel is now a flat tree: double-click rename, HTML5 drag with before/after/inside drop targets (artboards only reorder at the top level; moves into a layer itself are refused), hide/show and lock toggles on hover (always shown when on), collapse state per file, Shift range and Cmd toggle selection, and a context menu (Rename, Duplicate, Hide/Show, Lock/Unlock, Wrap in frame, Copy as HTML, Delete). Built and pushed to main. Wrap in frame (Cmd+Opt+G), Unwrap (Cmd+Shift+G), align six ways, distribute horizontally and vertically, and bring forward/backward/to front/to back (Cmd+], Cmd+[, with Shift for front/back). All are in a new Arrange menu in the menu bar, enabled per selection, and in a right-click menu on the canvas, which is the same layer menu as the layers panel (minus Rename). Positions are measured from the canvas DOM in layout units, so zoom does not affect them. One child of a flex container aligns on the cross axis with align-self; the main axis shows a notice that it comes from the parent justify-content. Every command is one undo step. 6/6 acceptance checks; full suite (18 suites) green. Built. Measured on the 300-artboard, 30,900-layer stress file (scripts/stress-file.ts, test: bun run test:perf): first paint 1.1 s (was 3.6), pan 120 fps (was 2-5), zoom 120+ fps, overview pan 115 fps, drag 0 dropped frames, typing 24 ms worst, agent update_styles 43 ms with the MCP round trip, layers scroll p95 9 ms (was 67). Changes: off-screen artboards get content-visibility: hidden, and measuring for MCP reads, sizes and comment pins lays them out for that moment, so get_node_info sizes match; the world is promoted to a compositor layer while the viewport moves; layers panel mounts only the rows in view; pages and comments rows use content-visibility: auto (their heights vary, so they stay in the DOM); previews are per-layer subscriptions, so a drag frame re-renders only the layers it moves; node and panel components are memoized; per-page scans (fonts, colors, layer ids) are cached per artboard. Found along the way: a caret left on the canvas after text editing slowed every frame afterwards; the editor now clears it when it closes. Full suite passes (18 suites).

Built. The styles panel has an Image group for image layers (Fit: Fill, Fit, Stretch, Original; a 3 x 3 anchor grid plus a free position field; Replace image) and the same group for frames with a background image (background-size, position and repeat). Replace keeps the layer's ID, name and styles and is one undo step; Alt + drop of an image file on an image layer replaces its picture. get_computed_styles now reports object-position and the background size, position and repeat. Checks: 5/5 in tests/images.test.ts; full suite 19/19 suites passing.

Built. Pasting from other apps: images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) become image layers at natural size, scaled to fit and kept inside the target; SVG (as text or image/svg+xml) becomes a sanitized SVG layer; HTML converts with write_html's rules and a notice lists what was left out; plain text becomes a text layer. The target is the selected frame or artboard, the container of a selected layer, or the artboard at the middle of the view. Markup copied as text from a code editor is converted from the text rather than the editor's highlighted HTML. Copying layers now also writes text/html (same as Copy as HTML) next to the JSX text/plain; pasting inside OpenDraw still uses the exact internal format. Each paste is one undo step and selects what it added; pasting in a text field is left alone. Checks: 7/7 in tests/clipboard.test.ts; full suite 20/20 suites passing.
